user_query: I want to surprise my family with a special dinner and I'm looking for discount coupons to save on restaurant expenses. Fetch all the available coupons from different restaurants and suggest the most popular ones. Additionally, provide me with a website where I can find free coupon codes to save on other expenses related to the dinner.

TaskList.description: Fetch all available coupons from different restaurants.
Suggest the most popular coupons based on the fetched data.
Find and recommend a website that lists free coupon codes for additional savings.
